author: janet zeanah
text: What a wonderful experience I had with this Company. I was scheduled quickly. The technicians were punctual, professional, and did an excellent job. The price of my repairs were very reasonable.  I will definitely call on them again.

author: Jeremy Hudson
text: Very pleasant interaction with One Call. Gunner came out and was very kind and courteous. He did resolved our plumbing issue quickly and efficiently. He was very knowledgeable and provided a lot of great information. He spent time educating us when he didn't have to. I would contact One Call again in a jiffy based on this interaction.

author: Tif Wilks
text: I called One Call on a Sunday morning and Josh told me someone would be at my home by noon. Well, Chris was at my home before noon. He was very professional, nice, and patient. These guys definitely know what they are doing. I will and have recommended them and I would definitely use them again if needed.

author: Andrew Oakland
text:
They completed the job without any major problems but several small issues lead to my 3 star rating.
1) The company is called 'One Call' services but it took two calls to schedule an appointment - I spoke to someone once but no one called me back as he said they would, so I had to call again.
2) They said the caulk they used would be set after 24 hours but it took 48 hours, I almost ruined the project on accident because of that.
3) Their website says they offer new customers $50 off. After I paid them for their work I realized that they had not subtracted this discount. When I asked them about this, their response was essentially 'You didn't mention the promotion at the right time, but we will let you try again next time.'

author: Victoria Woods
text: Just had two gentlemen by the name of Gunnar and Austin come service my home and they were the absolute best! Very professional, personable and repaired my toilet in a matter of minutes. I would definitely recommend this business to family and friends in the future!
